Hussain

1
Maqtal Me Jub Hussain Pe Khanjar Rawa Hua,
Zainab Thi Ek Ret Ke Teele Pe Gam Zada,

2
Karte The Bain Arz O Sama….. Wa Musibata
Markad Me Apne Khaak Udhate Te The Mustafa(sawaw)
Jalti Zameen Pe Bain Yeh Karti Thi Sayyada

3
Ro Ro Ke Ahle Sham Se Kehti Thi Sayyada
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya
Hussain, Hussain

4
Ghar Fatema Ka Loot Liya Fauje Sham Ne
Luta Hai Kisne Ummat E Khairul Anam Ne
Pyasi Nabi Ki Aal Thi Darya Ke Saamne
Din Bhar Uthaie Maiyate Shah E Anam Ne
Peer O Jawan Kurban Kiye Tashnakaam Ne
Aaya Na Koi Bhi Mere Bacche Ko Tham Ne
Sabro Raza Ke Sare Imtehan De Gay

5
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

6
Ek Sar Ajal Ne Maanga Bahattar Fida Kiye
Ashab E Ba Wafa Tahe Khanjar Fida Kiye
Pale Hue Sub God Ke Has Kar Fida Kiye
Zainab Ke Do Haseen Gul E Tar Fida Kiye
Jaun O Habib O Hur Se Baradar Fida Kiye
Deen E Khuda Pe Akbar O Asgar Fida Diye
Dard E Judaie Qasim O Abbas Ka Mila

7
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

8
Kya Haq Rasool E Pak (sawaw) Ka Tumne Ada Kiya
Har Zulm Ko Hussain Pe Tumne Rawa Kiya
Lekin Mere Hussain Ne Dekho To Kya Kiya
Jo Wada Bachpane Me Kiya Tha Wafa Kiya
Karbobala Ki Khak Ko Khaak E Shifa Kiya
Jalti Zameen Pe Shukra Ka Sajda Ada Kiya
Mazloomi Yat Ki Sari Hadein Par Kar Gaya

9
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

10
Banjar Zameen Ki Shan Badhaie Hussain Ne
Teeron Ki Janamaz Bichaie Hussain Ne
Aaisi Namaz Ban Me Padhaie Hussain Ne
Teg O Tabar Ki Pyas Bujhaie Hussain Ne
Tawheed Apne Khoon Se Bachaie Hussain Ne
Falaq Ki Kabr Ban Me Banaie Hussain Ne
Noke Sina Pe Bolta Quran Ho Gaya

11
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

12
Tha Teen Shab O Roz Ka Pyasa Mera Hussain
Nargha Tha Sitamgaron Ka Tanha Mera Hussain
Tanha Har Ek Shaheed Ko Roya Mera Hussain
Zakhmon Se Jub Ke Choor Hua Tha Mera Hussain
Ghode Se Kya Zameen Pe Aaya Mera Hussain
Na Zeen Na Zameen Pe Thaira Mera Hussain
Buz Sajda E Tazeem Me Sar Ko Jhuka Diya

13
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

14
AsgharKi Kabr Khod Ke Roti Thi Zulfeqar
Kitna Neyam Me Sabr Mein Tadpi Thi Zulfeqar
Zainab Ki Tarha Sog Me Rehti Thi Zulfeqar
Woh Ke Adu Ke Khoon Ki Pyasi Thi Zulfeqar
Hanga Me Asr Nyam Se Nikli Thi Zulfeqar
Yeh Fauj E Be Murad Se Kehti Thi Zulfeqar
Tum Iski Jung Dekho Jo Barbad Ho Gaya

15
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

16
Jub Tak Sipa He Sham Se Yeh Keh Ke Purmalal
Tum Uski Jung Dekho Jo Sadmon Se Hai Nidhal
Mai Fauj E Na Murad Se Karta Hun Ek Sawal
Mujrim Tumhara Mai Tha Ya Bano Ka Nawnihal
Akbar Se Naujawn Ka Tumne Kiya Qital
Qasim Ki Lash Ghodon Se Ki Tum Ne Paymal
Ab Uski Jung Dekho Jo Lashe Utha Chukka

17
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

18
Tum Kya Samajh Rahe The Ke Ghar Ko Ujad Kar
Qasim Se Nawjan Pe Ghode Guzar Kar
Akbar Ke Dil Me Zulm Ki Barchi Utar Kar
Bayat Milengi Teer Se Asgar Ko Maar Kar
Mai Mutmain Hun Deen Pe In Sub Ko Maar Kar
Noke Sina Pe Sar Mera Rakhonge Haar Kar
Goonjengi Qaiyanat Me Har Simt Ek Sada

19
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

20
Farhan Nawhakhwan Hai Ya Mazhar Abedi
Dete Hai Is Jahan Ko Paigam Bus Yehi
Yeh Jo Gali Gali Mein Hai Lashe Biche Hue
Har Waqt Ke Yazeed (La) Ki Koshish Hai Aaj Bhi
Mit JAaye Is Jahan Se Majlis Hussain Ki
Wada Magar Hussain Ki Madar Se Hai Yehi
Jaan De Kar Karte Jaienge Matam Hussain Ka

21
Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya

22
Ya Janabe Sayyada Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Ya Ali E Murtaza Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Saiyad E Abrar Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Shah Ke Ansar Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Sheh Ke AlamdarKe Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Akbar Ke Zeejah Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Qasim E Noshah Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Aun O Mohammad Ke Bhi Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Bali Sakina Ke Bhi Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Asghar E Masoom Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Shahzadi E Qulsoom Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Zainab E Nashad Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum
Han Sayyad E Sajjad Ke Aaye Hai Purse Ko Hum

Ya Janabe Sayyada

# Keep the imported wording and normalize verse case and pronunciation metadata.
import re
names = dict((name.lower(), name) for name in (
    'Hussain Zainab Mustafa Sayyada Sham Fatema Nabi Jaun Habib Hur Khuda Akbar Asgar Asghar Qasim Abbas Karbobala Quran Zulfeqar Bano Farhan Mazhar Abedi Yazeed Ali Murtaza Aun Mohammad Sakina Qulsoom Sajjad'.split()
))
roman = re.sub(r' ?\\((?:sawaw|La)\\)', '', roman)
def verse_case(line):
    line = re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]+', lambda m: names.get(m[0].lower(), m[0].lower()), line)
    return line[:1].upper() + line[1:]
roman = '\\n'.join(map(verse_case, roman.splitlines()))
blocks = source.split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = roman.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(blocks) == len(roman_blocks) == 24
for n, (original, transcription) in enumerate(zip(blocks, roman_blocks)):
    assert len(original.splitlines()) == len(transcription.splitlines())
    if n:
        assert original.splitlines()[0].translate(str.maketrans('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹', '0123456789')) == transcription.splitlines()[0] == str(n)
meta = meta.replace('language: \"Urdu\"', 'alternateTitle: \"Haye Mere Hussain Pe Kya Waqt Aagaya\"\\nlanguage: \"Urdu\"')
meta = meta.replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
p.write_text('---' + meta + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines()) + '\\n---\\n\\n' + source + '\\n')
print(f'Checked {len(blocks)-1} numbered blocks and {sum(len(block.splitlines()) for block in blocks)-23} verses including the opening.')
